root_cause: Existing mandatory chat-learning preflight validates incident protocol text/skill marker but has no observed-provider-event to canonical Brain receipt and recovery readback reconciliation; errors can be unreported while preflight says READY. Effective runtime coverage is not proven.
fix: Original preflight now evaluates optional independently observed provider event/Brain receipt/recovery evidence using one pure scoped incident-assurance module, exposes UNREPORTED_FAILURE_DETECTED, SAFE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, RECOVERY_NOT_PROVEN, INCIDENT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT, SOURCE_COVERAGE_UNVERIFIED and independent verified status. No alternate issuer of incidents, scheduler or registry.
prevention_rule: All original runtime owners must submit provider observations and genuine brain_observe_failure occurrence readbacks to ONE BRAIN before reporting completion. Any missing receipt, repeated error, unattempted safe repair, missing regression/provider readback, or incomplete observation scope fails closed and is a durable existing-owner obligation. Without independently observed provider coverage never claim global green.
